transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2025-08-12
Start: 15:00 PT
Duration: 00:44:00
Attendees: Asha, Devon, Leo, Nora, Maya, Samir, Priya, Ethan

Summary: Quick campaign sync for upcoming webinar on inference economics and serving strategies. Align on dates, channels, assets, registration goals, tracking, and next steps.

[00:00] Asha Patel: ok everyone, thanks for jumping on, um we'll do a quick 40 minute sync on the webinar, trying to keep it tight. Maya, can you confirm the target date again?
[00:10] Maya Chen: yeah we set the live date for Thursday 2025-08-28 at 10am PT. that's still good unless someone flags a conflict.
[00:18] Devon Kim: sounds good, that gives us two weeks for promo which is tight but doable. what's our registration target? last quarter we did 600 regs, should we aim for 800?
[00:29] Samir Das: I think 800 is ambitious but reasonable with a partner push, Nora's partner channel could add 150-200, plus paid social.
[00:37] Nora Lee: yeah our partner said they'd include it in their newsletter if we provide hero image and two lines of copy by next Friday.
[00:45] Asha Patel: ok call that out as a task. Priya, slide deck status?
[00:50] Priya Nair: working through draft, I have outline: intro + market context, serving/runtime overview, economics case study, demo snippet, Q&A. need speaker notes and we should keep deck under 25 slides.
[01:05] Leo Ramirez: visual direction: we want a simplified explainer for the demo slide, a couple of diagrams on routing/batching, and a final slide with CTA to start a pilot. I'll do three variations of the hero image.
[01:18] Devon Kim: speaking of CTA, landing page, HubSpot form needs to include checkboxes for email consent and interest (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). Also add hidden fields for campaign source and utm_medium.
[01:32] Maya Chen: yes I'll set up the HubSpot form, we should also enable GA4 and our webinar tracking so conversions flow to the funnel.
[01:40] Ethan Cole: platform choice — are we still planning to use Zoom webinar + recording? We might consider StreamYard for studio style.
[01:48] Asha Patel: Zoom webinar is fine for this one, we can record cloud and export later. just need to confirm recording release on the registration page. Priya, add a line about recordings and repurpose.
[01:58] Priya Nair: noted.
[02:02] Samir Das: promo cadence — paid social starts 10 days out, organic 14 and 7 days out, two reminder emails (3 days before, 1 day before) and day-of email. Also a follow-up with recording and CTA to book pilot within 48 hours.
[02:20] Devon Kim: for paid we'll test copy A/B: cost-focused vs performance-focused. Low CPA target: $15-25 per registration.
[02:30] Asha Patel: who owns the ad budget?
[02:33] Samir Das: growth will allocate $3k initial test, can scale if CPA is good.
[02:38] Nora Lee: partner co-promo — I need partner logo, short bio, and approved intro copy by Monday.
[02:45] Leo Ramirez: I'll deliver three assets by Wednesday EOD.
[02:49] Devon Kim: tracking: please add hidden field for "model_type_interest" because we want to know if folks are interested in hosted vs dedicated vs private. also tag all registrants who come from partner link.
[03:02] Maya Chen: noted. CRM integration with HubSpot should be straightforward. I'll create the list and automated workflows: registered -> reminder sequence -> webinar attended -> follow-up sequence.
[03:13] Asha Patel: ok let's talk speakers and flow. who will open and who does demo?
[03:18] Priya Nair: Asha opens with market context and thesis, Samir will cover the economics case study, Devon will do the demo snippet focusing on latency/cost tradeoffs and routing policies, and Nora will do partner intro. Q&A moderated by Ethan.
[03:30] Ethan Cole: I can moderate, I'll triage questions to speakers and record the top 5.
[03:35] Samir Das: demo content we need a short 5 minute pre-recorded clip for the live session to avoid demo flakiness, plus a live Q&A.
[03:45] Devon Kim: yes I'll record a 4-5 minute demo showing request routing and batching settings; might use the staging tenant and a canned load so it's deterministic. will need SE support to get a clean run.
[03:56] Asha Patel: action: Devon to coordinate with SE for demo run and provide pre-recorded by 2025-08-19.
[04:03] Priya Nair: what about the registration copy? we should highlight "production-grade serving" and "real latency/cost metrics" plus a case study headline.
[04:12] Maya Chen: add privacy note: recording consent + data handling in event — marketing folks asked about storing recorded attendee lists in HubSpot, is that okay?
[04:20] Asha Patel: fine but ensure we follow our data retention policy; if partners require different handling we'll note that in partner agreement.
[04:27] Nora Lee: partner asked if we can co-brand slide with their logo, and it's OK as long as they sign off on the recording clip.
[04:34] Leo Ramirez: small design question: social thumbnail needs to work at 1200x628 and also in 1:1 for LinkedIn. I'll export both sizes.
[04:44] Devon Kim: emails — I'll draft 4 templates: invite, reminder 3d, reminder 1d, follow-up with recording + CTA. Will post to the marketing drive.
[04:54] Asha Patel: timing for dry-run? we said 2025-08-19 for dry-run, can we lock a time?
[04:58] Priya Nair: I'm available 10am PT that day, Devon?
[05:02] Devon Kim: 10am PT works.
[05:04] Asha Patel: set it — dry-run 2025-08-19 10:00 PT.
[05:07] Samir Das: one more item — success metrics: registrations, live attendees, demo requests, qualified leads (SQLs) from follow up. We'll define targets in the deck.
[05:17] Maya Chen: I'll set up dashboards for registrants and conversion to attendees in GA and HubSpot.
[05:22] Asha Patel: perfect. quick notes on legal: we need a short snippet for the registration page for recording consent and TOS link. Nathan in legal will review but keep short.
[05:34] Nora Lee: partner needs co-promotion plan doc — I'll share a template by Tuesday.
[05:40] Priya Nair: I'll finalize deck and speaker notes, + create a 2 slide speaker bio pack for intros.
[05:47] Asha Patel: recapping action items and owners, see notes. Any blockers?
[05:52] Ethan Cole: none from events side.
[05:54] Devon Kim: no blockers.
[05:55] Asha Patel: ok thanks everyone. We'll reconvene briefly next week if needed. Meeting adjourned.
topics: Landing page and HubSpot form setup
